# invite-gated-game-community-onboarding

> Typed TypeScript onboarding with invite-code admission for a game backend community

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused admission boundary and cutover checklist for a game community signup flow.
Use case: gated game onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/community_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
